page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, supported by a 33 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 23.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.75 GB per core. For graphics and parallel processing, it includes a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU with a 0.25x allocation and 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not included, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Benchmarks indicate that this instance sits in the lower tiers of performance. Both single-core and multi-core CPU tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the processor in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with uncached large-block reads scoring in the bottom 10% at 19.82 GB/sec. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as bzip3 decompression and Passmark encryption, consistently rank in the weak or poor categories. The fractional GPU provides entry-level acceleration, but the 4 GB VRAM limit restricts its use to smaller models, as evidenced by a weak rating for 135M parameter LLM inference.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers an entry point for workloads requiring GPU acceleration without the expense of a full, dedicated GPU. However, the tradeoff is lower CPU and memory performance. Lacking local storage, it relies entirely on network-attached storage. This configuration is suitable for lightweight virtual desktop infrastructure, entry-level 3D rendering, basic CUDA development, or running small machine learning inference models that fit within the 4 GB VRAM boundary.
